description: The page templates of a database or data source, with their page ids, names and default flags. Use this catalog to distinguish templates from ordinary rows; search can return both. Inspect their pages before editing recurring content. Follow nextCursor when hasMore is true.

account.description: Workspace: a label list_accounts names ("*": every one). Rarely needed: an id or URL finds its own.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, exactly as it came back, to read on.

database.description: The database: its id, its Notion URL, or the dataSourceId search returned for it.

source.description: Which table, only when the database holds several (describe_database lists them): its name or id.
